import type { Species } from './types'
import { sprig } from './sprig'

import { mossroll } from './mossroll'
import { inkfold } from './inkfold'
import { kilnby } from './kilnby'
import { tuck } from './tuck'

/**
 * Every species but the default. `mochi`, the round orange one, is drawn in
 * code (hooks/pixels.ts) and is not listed here.
 */
export const SPECIES: readonly Species[] = [sprig, mallow, dewdrop, plumcap, luma, mossroll, inkfold, kilnby, tuck]

export function speciesById(id: string): Species | undefined {
  return SPECIES.find(s => s.id === id)
}

import type { ActivityKind, BandMode, Pet, Place, Skin, Stage } from '../types'
import type { Mood } from './pet'

export type Lang = 'zh' | 'en'

/** What the pet answers a care action with; text picks the words. */
export type Line =
  | 'egg' | 'asleep' | 'full' | 'fed' | 'tired' | 'played' | 'clean' | 'cleaned' | 'wake' | 'night'
  | 'healed' | 'healthy' | 'sickPlay'

/** Reads a language from Claude Code's `language` setting (`chinese`, `zh-CN`, `english`). */
export function langOf(value: string | undefined): Lang | undefined {
  if (value === undefined || value === '') return undefined
  const v = value.toLowerCase()
  if (/^(zh|cn)|chinese|中文|简体|繁體|繁体/.test(v)) return 'zh'
  return 'en'
}

const pick = <T,>(list: readonly T[]): T => list[Math.floor(Math.random() * list.length)] as T
